ContentBlocks.PlainTextContent:
If the Subframe locking pin signal is lost while the Stacker is moving

-Place Stacker in Maintenance
-Select tabs Maintenance/Drive Free on the Ketop
-Select Bypass Interlocks On button
-Jog the Subframe to repair location, repair lock switch signal
-When maintenance is turned off the Bypass Interlocks logic resets automatically
